verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms that an ElevenLabs API exists, along with llms.txt, markdown docs and a hosted MCP server. None of it documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec. llms.txt and markdown doc pages are documentation-access features, not an API specification, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
